The U.S. Department of State further specifies that exploitation includes forced labor, forced marriage, forced sexual exploitation, and forced organ removal.

These legal definitions emphasize the coercive nature of the crime and the exploitation of vulnerable individuals, distinguishing it from consensual migration or employment.
